carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible at the junction of the caudal peduncle and the caudal fin, defined by a high-luminance upper edge and a shadowed lower edge creating a sharp vertical intensity gradient.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, dark indentation or notch is visible on the dorsal leading edge of the caudal peduncle; irregular dark pigmentation patches are visible on the ventral lobe of the caudal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin exhibits a distribution of high-luminance circular blobs across both the upper and lower lobes, which are distinct from the primary flank patterning typically found posterior to the gills.
